questions.subject: Neural Networks
questions.question: Explain the difference between perceptron and weight initialization in Neural Networks.
questions.ideal_answer: perceptron and weight initialization differ in several ways: perceptron is simplest neural unit (works by linear binary classifier) whereas weight initialization is starting parameter values (works by training convergence facilitation). perceptron is typically used for weighted sum + step function, while weight initialization is used for Xavier/Glorot, He initialization. Example demonstrating perceptron: y = sign(w·x + b). Example demonstrating weight initialization: W ~ N(0, sqrt(2/fan_in)).
